subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers adopt this stale timeline PR as the basis for a current-architecture implementation, or close it and keep the calendar/timeline request tracked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644?
rationale: The PR is a new Control UI feature with useful proof but it is stale, conflicting, narrower than the canonical request, and needs non-trivial retargeting plus contract fixes before merge.

options.title: Sponsor A Current-Architecture Replacement
options.body: Use this PR as source material, but require a rebased or replacement branch that targets `ui/src/pages/cron`, preserves current `cron.status`, and fixes scheduler/state/i18n blockers before merge.

options.title: Close This Branch, Keep The Issue
options.body: Close this PR as a stale implementation candidate while keeping the canonical issue open for a fresh scoped design or implementation.

options.title: Pause For Broader Calendar Design
options.body: Defer code review until maintainers define whether the first slice should be a 24-hour strip or the broader day/week/editing calendar requested in the issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor A Current-Architecture Replacement
recommendation.body: Use this PR as source material, but require a rebased or replacement branch that targets `ui/src/pages/cron`, preserves current `cron.status`, and fixes scheduler/state/i18n blockers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Cron Jobs page product work makes this the strongest current routing signal for deciding whether to adopt, replace, or close this stale feature branch.
